alt: Aerial view of Nvidia's striking triangular headquarters campus in Santa Clara, California, with Apple Park visible in the distance
story: On November 12, 2026, Nvidia's board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation; on November 17 they stated publicly 'no plans to reinstate him'; on November 23 — after the company shed roughly $1.5 trillion in market cap and US government officials reportedly weighed in — the board unanimously reversed course and reinstated Huang as CEO, all within 11 days.
why_funny: The world's most valuable AI company built a succession plan, tested it for 11 days, lost $1.5 trillion, and immediately reverted — a live demonstration that the plan existed only on paper.
